name: openscreen
description: Make a demo video from one sentence: record the screen, edit and export it with OpenScreen.

interface.longDescription:
Turns one sentence into a finished demo video of an app or a feature. The openscreen-demo skill plans a short storyboard, records the window you choose with OpenScreen, adds zooms, captions and on-screen callouts, exports an MP4 and checks its frames, then attaches the video to a pull request or drafts a post on X that it publishes only after your yes.

OpenScreen is a free, open-source (MIT) screen recorder and video editor for Windows, macOS and Linux. The skill offers to install it if it is missing, and registers its MCP server, which runs locally and needs no account.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second demo video of the feature on my current branch.
Add a video of this change to my open pull request.
